title: Karlach's Head

sources.title: Moonrise Towers
markers: Successfully inserting a head or heart

summary: Deliver to Anders for Hunt the Devil or insert it in Balthazar’s altar to open his secret room.

fields.Acquisition: Take it from Karlach’s corpse if her head is recoverable.
fields.Hunt the Devil: Anders accepts it at the Risen Road tollhouse. If the head cannot be recovered, reporting Karlach’s death can still earn his sword.
fields.Moonrise Towers: Interact with Musty Tomes to expose the altar in Balthazar’s room, then insert the head to open the hidden chamber.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
